title: ChatGPT launches an app store, lets developers know it’s open for business
description: OpenAI is looking to populate its flagship chatbot with a host of new user experiences.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Pickle Robot adds Tesla veteran as first CFO
description: Jeff Evanson recently joined Pickle Robot as the company's first CFO as the startup has allegedly expanded its partnership with UPS.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Why British politicians are flocking to American tech giants
description: Former British Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne has joined OpenAI as managing director and head of OpenAI for Countries. He will run also Coinbase's internal advisory council.
author: Anna Heim

title: ChatGPT’s mobile app hits new milestone of $3B in consumer spending
description: ChatGPT has reached $3B in lifetime mobile consumer spending in just 31 months, faster than TikTok and major streaming apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Peripheral Labs taps into self-driving car sensors to bring sports fans right into the game
description: The startup has raised a $3.6 million seed round led by Khosla Ventures.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Luma releases a new AI model that lets users generate a video from a start  and end frame
description: Luma AI's new model is available through the company's Dream Machine platform.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Vibe-coding startup Lovable raises $330M at a $6.6B valuation
description: Lovable has seen its valuation more than triple just five months after the company's last funding round in July.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon’s new Alexa+ feature adds conversational AI to Ring doorbells
description: Amazon said that the feature uses the Ring doorbell's video descriptions to determine who the person in front of the camera is based on their uniform, actions, and what they are holding.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Adobe hit with proposed class-action, accused of misusing authors’ work in AI training
description: The lawsuit is just the latest in a string of copyright-related legal complaints aimed at the AI industry.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Amazon appoints longtime AWS exec Peter DeSantis to lead new AI org
description: DeSantis has spent 27 years at Amazon, including eight years as an SVP for AWS, the cloud provider that powers about one-third of the internet.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google launches Gemini 3 Flash, makes it the default model in the Gemini app
description: Google is making Gemini 3 Flash the default model in the Gemini app and oAI model for Search
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Mozilla’s new CEO says AI is coming to Firefox, but will remain a choice
description: Mozilla has appointed Anthony Enzor-DeMeo as its CEO as the Firefox developer scrambles to adapt in a rapidly changing browser market.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Google’s vibe-coding tool Opal comes to Gemini
description: The company on Wednesday said it is integrating the tool, which lets you build AI-powered mini apps, inside the Gemini web app, allowing users to create their own custom apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Skana Robotics helps fleets of underwater robots communicate with each other
description: Skana Robotics built a decision-making algorithm that helps unmanned vessels react and adapt to data from other vessels.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon reportedly in talks to invest $10B in OpenAI as circular deals stay popular
description: Amazon is in early discussions to invest as much as $10 billion in OpenAI in a deal that would see the AI lab using the e-commerce giant's AI chips.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Weeks after raising $100M, investors pump another $180M into hot Indian startup MoEngage
description: The deal valued MoEngage at "well over" $900 million post-money.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: DoorDash rolls out Zesty, an AI social app for discovering new restaurants
description: Users can view and share photos and comments about restaurants they’ve visited, discover content from others, and follow people just like on any social network.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Meta’s AI glasses can now help you hear conversations better
description: Conversation focus uses the AI glasses' open-ear speakers to amplify the voice of the person you're talking to, says Meta.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI continues on its ‘code red’ warpath with new image generation model
description: OpenAI rolls out GPT Image 1.5 for ChatGPT, promising 4x faster generation, better instruction-following, and precise edits. The launch  escalates its rivalry with Google Gemini.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Uber Eats alum lands $14M seed from a16z to fix WhatsApp chaos for LatAm’s doctors
description: Leona Health built an AI co-pilot to manage the flood of patient messages Latin American doctors receive on WhatsApp.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Google tests an email-based productivity assistant
description: Google's new email-based assistant will be available to AI Pro and Ultra plan users over the age of 18 in North America.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Databricks raises $4B at $134B valuation as its AI business heats up
description: The data intelligence company has just raised more than $4 billion in a Series L funding round at a $134 billion valuation — up 34% from the $100 billion valuation that it achieved just three months ago.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Adobe Firefly now supports prompt-based video editing, adds more third-party models
description: Adobe is updating its AI video-generation app, Firefly, with a new video editor that supports precise prompt-based edits, as well as adding new third-party models for image and video generation, including Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 and Topaz Astra.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Everbloom built an AI to turn chicken feathers into cashmere
description: Everbloom has also developed a chemical process to transform waste fibers and feathers into upcycled materials that resemble everything from polyester to cashmere.
author: Tim De Chant

title: VCs discuss why most consumer AI startups still lack staying power
description: The next consumer tech revolution may require an introduction of a new personal device.
author: Marina Temkin

title: OpenAI-backed biotech firm Chai Discovery raises $130M Series B at $1.3B valuation
description: Chai is building foundation models for drug discovery, specifically to predict interactions between  molecules so they could be reprogramed for cures.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Disney’s OpenAI deal is exclusive for just one year  — then it’s open season
description: After the one year is up, Disney is free to sign similar deals with other AI companies.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Nvidia bulks up open source offerings with an acquisition and new open AI models
description: Nvidia acquired SchedMD, the lead developer of Slurm, and launched the Nemotron 3 family of open source AI models.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Creative Commons announces tentative support for AI ‘pay-to-crawl’ systems
description: The organization offered support for this idea of an AI marketplace, and  suggested several guiding principles.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Lightspeed raises record $9B in fresh capital
description: The massive fund haul will allow the Silicon Valley firm to continue to invest in cash-hungry AI startups.
author: Marina Temkin
